tickets.title: Start retirement plan rollover
tickets.text: Start preparing the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) rollover for Nadia Copperwisp after her separation at the end of September 2024. The plan holds about $914,000, with 38% in company stock, 52% in diversified equity funds, and 10% in stable value holdings; coordinate receiving the account registration and the company-stock portion.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-06 to start preparing the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) move after separation, including receiving account registration and company-stock portion.

tickets.title: Obtain formal pension election packet
tickets.text: Obtain the formal pension election packet from Nadia Copperwisp's pension plan so the election can be completed; only portal estimates were available previously. The options include single-life pension, joint-and-survivor pension for Galen Copperwisp, and delayed Social Security.
tickets.evidence: By 2024-08-23, the formal pension election packet is needed because only portal estimates were available.

tickets.title: Review first-year retirement income and withholding
tickets.text: Review Nadia Copperwisp's first-year retirement income and tax withholding, incorporating the final paycheck from Silver Marmot Laboratories, the unused vacation payout, and the first pension timing into the tax projection. Estimated regular retirement spending is about $8,400 monthly before travel or home projects.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-13 to review first-year retirement income and withholding because Tobin noted final paycheck, unused vacation payout, and first pension timing were not yet in the tax projection.
